title: Tiki Taxi and Cruises
specs: Covered boat allowing operation in rain or shine

blurb: Guests can hop on the Tiki Taxi during regular hours for $10 per person per day and ride as long as they want. Private parties are available outside regular hours for groups of 17-49 guests, including a three-hour private cruise with open bar and bartender. The boat is covered and operates rain or shine.
extraNote: No dogs allowed on the Tiki Taxi · Boat operates rain or shine; captain may cancel due to weather with updates on social media · Prices do not include sales tax and gratuity
